subject: Evidence request: cage & bridge network diagrams for Dedicated/Private
messages:
From: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@blueriver.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: cage & bridge network diagrams for Dedicated/Private

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. BlueRiver is moving toward a Dedicated deployment for a customer pilot and our security team has a few specific asks before we can approve: we need a short packet that explains how Redwood implements physical/cage isolation (if applicable), the "bridge" connectivity model you mentioned for private VPCs, and the CAIQ/SIG mappings that reference those controls.

Concretely, can you provide: 
- A high-level network diagram showing the cage (hardware/host) boundary vs. logical tenant isolation for Dedicated and Private.
- A control-plane vs. data-plane callout (where KMS/HSM keys live, control-plane endpoints, where telemetry exits).
- A CAIQ/SIG crosswalk file that points to the artifacts above.

Our timeline is tight — can we get an initial handoff by next Tuesday (7/13)? I can loop in our security lead (security@blueriver.com) if helpful.

Thanks,
Tom
---
Tom Hsu
Director, Cloud Security
BlueRiver Analytics

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@blueriver.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: cage & bridge network diagrams for Dedicated/Private

Tom — great to hear from you and glad the demo was useful. We're able to produce a compact "handshake" package that covers exactly those three items. Plan below: 

1) Visuals: cage vs tenant overlay diagram (PDF), control-plane/data-plane callout (PNG) 
2) Artifact: CAIQ/SIG mapping spreadsheet with cell-level links to diagrams and policy snippets (XLSX) 
3) Appendix: bridge appendix (PPTX) describing cross-VPC NAT/route translation and allowed egress patterns for private deployments.

I've attached the first-cut visuals: cage_topology_v1.pdf and controlplane_callout.png. Kimberly is cc'd to confirm any SOC 2 wording and Vivek to coordinate the appendix text. If Tuesday 7/13 works we can do a 30-minute walk-through and I can hand off the SIG/CAIQ mapping afterwards.

Would you prefer the CAIQ crosswalk as a standalone spreadsheet or a shared Drive folder with individual artifacts?

Best,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: cage_topology_v1.pdf (diagram, 2 pages), controlplane_callout.png (image, callout)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@blueriver.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: cage & bridge network diagrams for Dedicated/Private

Tom — looping in formally. Thanks for the clear asks. A couple of clarifying points so we can make the package review-ready for your auditors: 

- "Cage" in our context refers to a host-physical separation and where customers have dedicated tenancy on a node pool. We'll annotate the diagram to show hardware demarcation (rack/host) + hypervisor boundary + tenant runtime plane.
- The "bridge" appendix will explicitly call out how we restrict cross-VPC routes (no inbound forwarding, egress via NAT gateways only by policy), and where we enforce tenant scoping (security groups, route policies).
- For CAIQ/SIG mapping: do you need the full control narrative (long-form) or are checkbox mappings sufficient for your SIG intake? We can provide both but it changes turnaround.

Attaching draft: bridge_appendix_draft.pptx (notes included). I'll prepare an encryption-boundary callout (KMS/HSM ownership, key wrapping boundaries) as a short addendum.

Kimberly Park
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
attachments: bridge_appendix_draft.pptx (10 slides, draft)

Subject: Re: Evidence request: cage & bridge network diagrams for Dedicated/Private

Aditya / Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments so far. This looks like the right shape. Couple items before we lock scheduling: 

- BlueRiver will need the CAIQ/SIG mapping as a spreadsheet (we ingest it directly into our vendor intake tool), with the SIG rows mapped to your artifacts. Can you deliver the XLSX by end of day Tuesday 7/13? If you can, we'll route to our auditors that night.
- We also need an explicit encryption-boundary diagram formatted as a single-page PDF showing where customer data is encrypted in-rest/in-transit and where keys are held/rotated (key owner: Redwood, customer-managed KMS option).
- Our security team would like a simple NDA before we share internal topology labels. Can you send a DocuSign link? I attached BlueRiver_SIG_ask.xlsx for your mapping and internal intake notes for context.

If you can do a 30-min sync Wednesday 7/14 at 10:00am PT, that would let us walk through the mapping. Otherwise Tuesday afternoon works too.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the packet.

Tom
security@blueriver.com
